title: Hammer & Stain

services.name: Animals With Flower Crowns
services.desc: These ultra-cute farm animals are sure to bring a little country flair to your home decor! Choose from four different animal stencil designs and multiple paint colors for the wood flowers to make the ultimate floral crown! Included in your kit:- Wood frame and wood flowers (choose at time of pick-up)- Gloves- Stain and paint colors- Sponges- One-use stencil- Instructions 4. On the personalization form, enter any specialized requests and personalized data needed in order to prepare your design (names, dates, etc) *see custom guidelines below Hammer @ Home Kits may be picked up from Hammer & Stain Tooele during the pick-up time selected. We will contact you using the contact info provided

services.name: Party package
services.desc: We would be happy to host you and your mini-makers special party! We have seating for up to 28 people and a wide variety of options to fit your child's interests and your budget! Custom projects are an option as well! We are happy to discuss options with you. If you have picked a date and time with the studio but do not know which project or number of guests, select the deposit option. After-hours parties in the studio (Elite, Premium, Grand and Standard packages) include table cloths, basic clean up and your own party host! We will have all of the supplies your group needs and easy instruction for a fun and stress free party your guests are sure to remember! No prep or cleanup required!
